name: Unblock Memory
description: Indexes, retrieves, and analyzes configured workspace memory with existing QMD vectors.

myTurn.enabled.label: My Turn
myTurn.enabled.help: Opt in to sending recent group/channel conversation text and agent identity to the configured decision model (default: https://codex.unblocklabs.ai/v1/decisions -> OpenRouter Liquid d1.2-ultra). Appends an advisory NO_REPLY hint only when the model clearly favors silence. DMs and internal wakes are excluded. Failures never prevent a turn. Requires hook conversation access and prompt injection. Disabled by default.

myTurn.historyMessages.label: My Turn Message Window
myTurn.historyMessages.help: Recent host-confirmed human messages including the trigger (1-50, default 10). Agent/bot/internal messages and unverified bundled history are excluded. If the trigger cannot be verified human, My Turn skips without affecting the agent turn.

myTurn.channels.label: My Turn Channel Overrides
myTurn.channels.help: Canonical provider IDs, e.g. slack or imessage. Once My Turn is enabled, omitted providers and omitted enabled flags default on. Set a provider's enabled to false to exclude it.

peoplePrimer.enabled.label: People Background Primer
peoplePrimer.enabled.help: Opt in to sending identity, approved excerpts and proposed snippets to the configured decision model (default: Codex LB -> OpenRouter Liquid d1.2-ultra). Prepares evidence and checks <=70-word blurbs before replace_dossier saves; disabled/unavailable reviews require explicit manual verification. Existing dossiers are not evidence. Results are accessible to the agent's tool callers.

peoplePrimer.corpora.label: Primer Approved Corpora
peoplePrimer.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpus allowlist. Sessions includes all indexed conversations; approve only content suitable for this agent's audiences.

responseAudit.enabled.label: Response Quality Audit
responseAudit.enabled.help: Opt in to background decision-model evaluation (default: Codex LB -> OpenRouter Liquid d1.2-ultra) of approved Slack humans. Operator-only reports; no prompt or memory writes.

responseAudit.sentimentEnabled.label: Human Sentiment Analysis
responseAudit.sentimentEnabled.help: Default on within an enabled, approved response audit. Includes annoyance, frustration and expressed intensity; does not imply agent fault.

responseAudit.intervalMinutes.label: Response Audit Interval (minutes)
responseAudit.intervalMinutes.help: Shared cadence for quality and enabled sentiment analysis. Unchanged successful exchanges are cached. Zero means manual-only.

responseAudit.senderIds.label: Approved Human Sender IDs
responseAudit.senderIds.help: Explicit human Slack user IDs whose exchanges may be sent to the configured decision model, or ["*"] to approve all verified Slack humans. Still requires trusted human identity or owner metadata; explicit bots and unverified senders are always excluded.

responseAudit.memoryCorpora.label: Response Audit Memory Evidence
responseAudit.memoryCorpora.help: Optional configured file corpora approved for current-index memory-gap investigation. Does not prove historical availability.

qualityAudit.enabled.label: Memory Quality Audit
qualityAudit.enabled.help: Enable an on-demand decision-model audit (default: Codex LB -> OpenRouter Liquid d1.2-ultra). Records review indicators only; never edits or suppresses data.

evidenceReview.enabled.label: Evidence Review
evidenceReview.enabled.help: Opt in to sending proposed claims and explicitly approved indexed evidence to the configured decision model (default: Codex LB -> OpenRouter Liquid d1.2-ultra). Advisory only; never writes.

evidenceReview.corpora.label: Evidence Review Corpora
evidenceReview.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpus approval for claim evidence sent to the configured decision model.

qualityAudit.corpora.label: Approved Audit Corpora
qualityAudit.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpora approved for external decision-model processing and maintenance results visible to every audience using this agent. Sessions means ALL indexed sessions, not only the current conversation.

decisionModel.enabled.label: Decision Model Judgments
decisionModel.enabled.help: Shared provider gate for My Turn, opted-in whisperers, people primer/save review, evidence/quality reviews and response audits. Does not enable features or approve corpora by itself. Memory search discovers locally and uses the configured decision model to rank usefulness; People Whisperer injection stays local.

decisionModel.endpoint.label: Decision Model Endpoint
decisionModel.endpoint.help: HTTPS (or loopback HTTP) decision API endpoint without credentials, query, or fragment. Defaults to https://codex.unblocklabs.ai/v1/decisions (OpenRouter Liquid d1.2-ultra).

decisionModel.model.label: Decision Model ID
decisionModel.model.help: Model alias sent to the decision endpoint. Defaults to liquid/d1.2-ultra.

decisionModel.timeoutMs.label: Decision Request Timeout
decisionModel.timeoutMs.help: Per-request timeout, not the whole operation. People primer/dossier review use peoplePrimer.timeoutMs instead; Memory Whisperer has its own total deadline, Skill Whisperer and My Turn have their own total deadlines.

decisionModel.apiKeyFile.label: Decision API Key File
decisionModel.apiKeyFile.help: Absolute path to a plaintext API key or a dotenv file (CODEX_LB_API_KEY, or DECISION_MODEL_API_KEY for custom endpoints). Use a key for the configured endpoint.

keepEmbeddingModelWarm.label: Keep Embedding Model Warm
keepEmbeddingModelWarm.help: Keep the QMD embedding model resident after first use. Disable to unload it after five minutes without model activity.

corpora.label: Memory Corpora
corpora.help: Named groups of exact Markdown files, directories, or globs. Relative paths resolve from each agent workspace. Skill files use the isolated skills corpus. Session corpora can expand matching semantic chunks up to maxExpandedTokens.

skillWhisperer.enabled.label: Skill Whisperer
skillWhisperer.enabled.help: Append relevant configured skills and retain them for the session. With decision-model credentials, sends the current request, recent conversation, and skill names and descriptions to the configured endpoint. Requires hook conversation access.

memoryWhisperer.enabled.label: Memory Whisperer
memoryWhisperer.enabled.help: Append up to three decision-model-approved historical excerpts after the user prompt. Requires explicit corpora, decision-model credentials (defaults to https://codex.unblocklabs.ai/v1/decisions -> OpenRouter liquid/d1.2-ultra), and hook conversation access. Disabled by default.

memoryWhisperer.corpora.label: Approved Hint Corpora
memoryWhisperer.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpus allowlist for automatic recall and decision-model processing (defaults to https://codex.unblocklabs.ai/v1/decisions -> OpenRouter liquid/d1.2-ultra). Session recall spans this agent's indexed sessions; the sessions corpus chatTypes setting controls direct-message inclusion.

safetyWhisperer.enabled.label: Safety Whisperer
safetyWhisperer.enabled.help: Prompt-level guardrail, not access control. Sends every checked human message and bounded recent history to the configured decision endpoint (defaults to https://codex.unblocklabs.ai/v1/decisions -> OpenRouter liquid/d1.2-ultra) and appends a scenario's flaggedPrompt when an unapproved requestor's message matches. Fails open: if the check cannot run, the turn proceeds without it. Requires hook conversation access and prompt injection. Disabled by default.

safetyWhisperer.scenarios.label: Safety Scenarios
safetyWhisperer.scenarios.help: Each scenario is judged independently. Approval and exclusions match exact provider/account/sender or channel IDs from trusted channel metadata, never names or message text.

people.enabled.label: PeopleSQL
people.enabled.help: Enable the agent-local people store, Slack identity observation and people tools. Disabled by default; whispering and decision-model primer/review are separate opt-ins.

people.whisperer.enabled.label: People Whisperer
people.whisperer.enabled.help: Supply identity, scoped preferences and unexpired agent lessons on every Slack user turn. Enables private nightly learning and weekly validation by default. Same-run retries replay their snapshot.

people.whisperer.maxChars.label: People Context Character Limit
people.whisperer.maxChars.help: Combined identity and interaction context limit. Identity blurb remains at most 70 words.

people.learning.enabled.label: People Learning
people.learning.enabled.help: Defaults on with People Whisperer. Private nightly dreaming at 03:10 and complete weekly validation Sunday at 04:00 in the agent timezone. Does not grant external-analysis or corpus approvals.

analysis.executable.label: Memory Analysis Worker
analysis.executable.help: Optional absolute path to the locally installed unblock-memory-analysis executable.

steward.enabled.label: Steward
steward.enabled.help: Master switch for the Steward sub-agent. Also enable steward.deepThought and/or steward.peopleShadow.

steward.deepThought.enabled.label: Deep Thought Curator
steward.deepThought.enabled.help: Registers the read-only deep_thought tool: a multi-hop memory investigation with verified citations.

steward.peopleShadow.enabled.label: People Shadow
steward.peopleShadow.enabled.help: Background, proposal-only review of People Learning manifests. Never publishes; compare with `openclaw memory-steward shadow-report`.

steward.outcomeLedger.enabled.label: Outcome Ledger
steward.outcomeLedger.enabled.help: Deterministic (no model call) background scoring of whether memory hits, skills and person whispers helped, were ignored or hurt. Inspect with `openclaw memory-steward outcomes`.

steward.endpoint.label: Steward Endpoint
steward.endpoint.help: HTTPS (or loopback HTTP) Responses API endpoint. Defaults to https://codex.unblocklabs.ai/v1/responses, which reuses the decision credential on the same origin.

steward.apiKeyFile.label: Steward API Key File
steward.apiKeyFile.help: Absolute path to a plaintext API key or dotenv file for the Steward endpoint. When unset, the decision credential is used only for the same origin.

expectationsWhisperer.enabled.label: Expectations Whisperer
expectationsWhisperer.enabled.help: Append open commitments, blockers and todos (from Captain's Log, people todos and Steward session extraction) that match the turn's channel, person, keywords or due window. Read-only local lookup, no model call. Enabled by default.

steward.skills.enabled.label: Self-Writing Skills
steward.skills.enabled.help: Review-only skill proposals (description updates, pitfall patches, new skills) in skill_proposals. Nothing touches a live SKILL.md until an operator runs `openclaw memory-steward skill-review <id> --approve` and `skill-apply <id>`.

fleetCommons.enabled.label: Fleet Commons
fleetCommons.enabled.help: Search a sanitized fleet-wide Commons feed as the "fleet" corpus. Requires fleetCommons.endpoint or fleetCommons.feedPath.

fleetCommons.description: Fleet Commons: a sanitized, fleet-wide feed of tool pitfalls, API workarounds, platform outages and procedures, re-validated locally (secrets, emails, phone numbers, Slack IDs, local paths, client identifiers), cached in SQLite and projected into QMD as the searchable "fleet" corpus (collection unblock-fleet). Off by default; enabling requires endpoint or feedPath. Inspect or sync with `openclaw memory-steward fleet-commons [--sync]`.

endpoint.description: HTTPS feed URL, or HTTP to localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]. No embedded credentials. Returns {"entries": [...]} and supports ETags.

feedPath.description: Absolute path to a local JSON feed file (used instead of endpoint).

apiKeyFile.description: Absolute path to a file holding the bearer token for endpoint.

syncIntervalMinutes.description: Background sync interval while the gateway runs. Default 15.

maxEntries.description: Entries kept after validation, most severe then most recently updated first. Default 0 = unlimited.

maxFeedBytes.description: Feed bytes read (streamed) before JSON parsing; a larger feed fails the sync and keeps the last good cache. Default 5242880 (5 MiB); 0 = unlimited.

maxTitleChars.description: Maximum length of a single-line entry title. Default 1024; 0 = unlimited.

maxBodyChars.description: Maximum length of an entry body. Default 65536; 0 = unlimited.

allowExpired.description: Keep and serve entries past their expiresAt. Default false.

syncIntervalMinutes.description: Check for session changes every N minutes while the Gateway runs; unchanged sessions skip indexing. 0 disables automatic sync. First check is after one interval.

api.description: Optional authenticated query-model API, used only when mode is "legacy". Ignored (never called) in the default v2 mode. An empty or omitted endpoint uses deterministic local queries unless overridden by operational defaults.

apiKeyFile.description: Absolute path to the API bearer token file. When unset or unreadable, Memory Whisperer falls back to deterministic local queries.

mlx.description: Deprecated and ignored. Remove this field and configure memoryWhisperer.api. Local workers are no longer launched by the plugin.

mode.description: Query planning mode. "v2" (default) uses one decision-model recall gate and corpus router plus one grounded topic extraction, then local QMD search; it never calls memoryWhisperer.api. "legacy" restores the query-model API path.

complementaryHints.description: Optionally remove confidently redundant hints with one decision-model request per directional pair. Uncertainty retains hints.

corpora.description: Explicit known non-skill corpus names (required when enabled). "extracted" is allowed only when extraction.enabled and extraction.publish are both true; "fleet" only when fleetCommons.enabled is true.

recipeHash.description: Retrieval recipe label stamped on memory exposures (Memory Whisperer and memory_search) for A/B experiments; surfaces in memory-steward outcomes byRecipe. Trimmed; defaults to "default".

derivedObservations.description: Whisper fresh, generation-verified deep_thought syntheses that match the turn in the same <memory> block. Local and deterministic (no model call); a synthesis stops being whispered as soon as a searched QMD collection changes.

derivedMaxHints.description: Verified deep_thought syntheses whispered per turn. 0 = unlimited.

derivedMinTokenOverlap.description: Minimum share of a stored question's meaningful tokens the turn must cover for a derived-observation whisper.

derivedMinSharedTokens.description: Minimum shared meaningful tokens for a non-exact derived-observation question match.

brightness.description: Re-orders usefulness-qualified finalists using recall (actr_v1), outcome (outcome_v1), or outcome plus emotional salience (emotion_v1) evidence. Read-only; missing evidence is neutral. Active recipes stamp brightness:<recipe> unless memoryWhisperer.recipeHash is set.

weight.description: Score added per unit of normalized brightness (-1..1). 0 disables re-ordering.

decayRate.description: actr_v1 power-law decay exponent per hour.

maxBoost.description: Absolute cap on the brightness adjustment.

emotionDecayStretch.description: emotion_v1 multiplies the 30-day outcome time constant by (1 + salience × emotionDecayStretch).

emotionMaxBonus.description: Maximum additive emotion_v1 bonus at peak salience. A confirmed hurt outcome suppresses the bonus.

crystalsEnabled.description: Whisper active Memory Crystals whose title and summary match the turn, in the same <memory> block after verified syntheses and before raw chunks. Local and deterministic (no model call); only workspace or same-audience crystals whose every corpus is in memoryWhisperer.corpora qualify.

crystalMinTokenOverlap.description: Minimum overlap coefficient between the turn and a crystal's title + summary tokens.

crystalMinSharedTokens.description: Minimum shared meaningful tokens for a crystal match.

crystalLtmRankBoost.description: Additive rank boost for long-term (ltm) crystals.

enabled.description: Defaults to true when a corpus with kind "skills" is configured, otherwise false. An explicit true without one is ignored with a warning.

cooldownTurns.description: Accepted for compatibility; active skills no longer cool down.

recipeHash.description: Retrieval recipe label stamped on skill routing exposures for A/B experiments; surfaces in memory-steward outcomes byRecipe. Trimmed; defaults to "default".

safetyWhisperer.description: Optional prompt-level guardrail for sensitive request scenarios. Fails open when the check cannot run.

excludedChannels.description: Channels where every safety scenario is skipped. Threads inherit their channel.

instructions.description: What requests this scenario covers, including exclusions.

flaggedPrompt.description: Appended next to the human message when an unapproved requestor's message matches.

minProbability.description: Minimum decision-model yes-probability that the current request is covered.

agentIds.description: Limit the scenario to these agents; omit for every agent.

expectationsWhisperer.description: Appends open commitments, predictions, blockers, decision outcomes and todos from the expectations table when a turn matches their channel, person, keywords or due window. Read-only and local (no model call). Enabled by default.

cooldownTurns.description: Turns an expectation stays suppressed in a session after it is shown; it resurfaces early once it becomes overdue (0 = no cooldown). Default 10.

dueLeadMs.description: An expectation due within this many ms is due_soon (0 = only overdue). Default 86400000 (24h).

maxPayloadChars.description: Character budget for the <expectations> block; entries are never sliced (0 = unlimited). Default 0.

includeWorkspaceBlockers.description: Surface every open workspace-wide blocker on any eligible user turn, not only on turns whose channel matches it. Default true.

recallLedger.description: Opt-in local ledger of retrieval queries (with decision-model token usage), candidate hits, memory_get reads, skill routing events and skill open events in unblock-memory.sqlite. Off by default.

steward.description: Steward sub-agent: the deep_thought memory curator tool and proposal-only People shadow adjudication. Enabled by default; set enabled: false to opt out.

lateEvidenceRescanMs.description: History re-scored behind the watermark to pick up late Response Audit / Inside Out evidence, in ms. 0 = the full lookbackMs; unset = up to two days.

expectations.description: Expectations pass (6th primitive). Captain's Log [BLOCKED] entries and open people todos are mirrored deterministically with no model call, even without a Steward runner; session extraction and the due/resolution sweep use the Steward model. Enabled by default.

dueLeadMinutes.description: Sweep open expectations due within this many minutes; overdue ones always qualify.

sweepAfterMinutes.description: Sweep open expectations older than this, due date or not.

workspaceSweepChatTypes.description: Session chat types whose conversations are evidence for sweeping workspace-audience expectations. Default ["channel"]; a 1:1 assistant can add "group" or "direct" (sessions must not be in excludeChatTypes); [] = none.

blockerAutoExpireMinutes.description: Auto-expire a mirrored Captain's Log blocker (and close its ledger entries) when its topic has not been re-captured within this many minutes. Default 4320 (72h); 0 = never auto-expire.

captainsLogDecisionResolve.description: After each Captain's Log append, close open expectations (filtered by captainsLogResolveChatTypes) the new entries explicitly resolve or break, with batched d1.2 choice calls (requires decisionModel.enabled). Default true.

captainsLogResolveChatTypes.description: Expectation chat types eligible for the post-Captain's-Log d1.2 check. Default ["workspace", "channel"]; add "group" or "direct" to opt in.

captainsLogResolveMinConfidence.description: Minimum probability of the chosen resolved/broken option before the post-Captain's-Log check applies it. Default 0.85.

captainsLogResolveTimeoutMs.description: Post-Captain's-Log d1.2 request timeout in ms. Default 15000; 0 = no plugin-side limit (the decisions SDK still caps one request at 60 s).

crystals.description: Memory Crystals pass: synthesizes workspace-audience STM crystals from QMD analysis clusters (Steward model), promotes STM to LTM on helped outcomes or whispered hits, and retires stale STM. Decay and promotion run without a model. Reclustering requires analysis.executable. Enabled by default.

reclusterMinIntervalMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between automatic reclusters. Default 720.

autoRecluster.description: Recluster missing or stale analysis before synthesis (only when analysis.executable is configured). Default true.

maxClustersPerRun.description: Synthesis model calls per pass; unchanged, private or ineligible clusters never count. Peak emotional salience gives eligible clusters a small priority boost. Default 0 = unlimited.

maxMembersPerCluster.description: Evidence members per synthesis. Salient excerpts are prioritized after corpus checks. Default 12; 0 = the analysis page limit.

stmStaleAfterMinutes.description: STM crystals retire after this many minutes without re-verification. Default 20160 (14 days); 0 = never.

ltmPromoteMinHelped.description: Promote to LTM after this many helped outcomes on member sources. Default 3.

ltmPromoteMinHits.description: ...or after this many whispered hits. Default 5.

allowedCorpora.description: Corpora crystals may cite; the only source of truth (nothing else is hardcoded). Default ["memory", "knowledge"] excludes sessions; add "sessions" to opt session transcripts in (e.g. on a 1:1 personal-assistant node). Unresolved native source ids are never eligible.

prioritizeEmotionalSalience.description: Let high-salience (Flashbulb) evidence take a bounded share (at most 1/4, at least one) of a cluster's member slots and nudge synthesis order; representative members keep the rest. Default true.

overnight.description: Overnight Thinking pass: Voltaire Drift (re-investigate moved or recurring questions with a fresh deep_thought and record truth shifts), Shortfall Post-Mortems (diagnose hurt outcomes) and Anticipatory Pre-Answering (verify recurring questions before their usual hour). Needs the Steward model; Voltaire and pre-answering also need steward.deepThought. Enabled by default.

quietHoursStartHour.description: With quietHoursEndHour: run only inside [start, end) local hours (wraps midnight, e.g. 22 to 6). Unset = normal schedule.

minRecurrence.description: Minimum repeats (or distinct days for a rhythm). Default 2.

lookaheadMinutes.description: Pre-answer window. Default 720; 0 = every weekday/hour slot.

minConfidence.description: Lowest diff confidence that records a shift. Default medium.

recallChatTypes.description: recall_queries chat types mined for recurring questions. Default ["channel", "group"].

saveDerivedObservations.description: Persist complete investigations as derived observations for instant whispers. Default true.

writeDailyLogNotes.description: Append a ❔ was / ✅ now note to <workspace>/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md for shifts allowed by dailyLogChatTypes and dailyLogCorpora. Default true.

dailyLogChatTypes.description: Audience kinds whose Voltaire shifts may reach the daily log or an audience-less core_memories anchor. Default ["workspace", "channel"]; add "group" or "direct" to opt in.

dailyLogCorpora.description: Corpora a Voltaire shift must draw all of its evidence from to reach the daily log or an audience-less core_memories anchor. Default ["memory", "knowledge"]; add "sessions" or "extracted" to opt in.

timeoutMs.description: Per model call and per investigation; 0 = unlimited.

skills.description: Self-writing skills (review-only): replay-validated routing description updates, grounded ## Pitfalls patches from hurt outcomes and post-mortems, and new SKILL.md drafts mined from procedural memory crystals. Every draft is a pending row in skill_proposals; the Steward never writes a live SKILL.md. Review with `openclaw memory-steward skills`, `skill-review <id> --approve|--reject` and `skill-apply <id>`, which writes only inside configured skills corpus roots. Needs the Steward model and a skills corpus; description replay also needs decisionModel. Enabled by default.

lookbackDays.description: History window for routing, opens, outcomes and post-mortems. Default 30; 0 = unlimited.

enableDescriptionOptimizer.description: Propose routing descriptions that beat the live one on a replay of real prompts through the production skill router. Default true.

enablePitfallPatches.description: Propose grounded ## Pitfalls bullets from hurt skill outcomes. Default true.

enableNewSkills.description: Draft new skills from procedural crystals no catalog skill covers. Default true.

minSamplesPerSkill.description: Labelled replay samples a skill needs before its description is optimized. Default 5.

minRecallGainPp.description: Replay gate: minimum recall gain in percentage points. Default 3.

maxFalseActivationPp.description: Replay gate: maximum false-activation increase in percentage points. Default 1.

maxCriticalRegressions.description: Replay gate: previously-routed positives the candidate may lose. Default 0.

minPositivesEvaluated.description: Successfully replayed positives a candidate needs before the recall gate can pass; fewer makes the replay indeterminate instead of vacuously passing. Default 1; 0 = no minimum.

minNegativesEvaluated.description: Successfully replayed negatives a candidate needs before the false-activation gate can pass; fewer makes the replay indeterminate. Default 1; 0 = no minimum.

maxReplayFailureRate.description: Share of replay examples whose scorer judgment may fail before the replay is indeterminate (a scorer outage is retried on the next pass, never recorded as attempted). Default 0.25; 1 = tolerate any.

maxDescriptionsPerRun.description: Description model calls per pass. Default 3; 0 = unlimited.

maxPitfallsPerRun.description: Pitfall model calls per pass. Default 3; 0 = unlimited.

maxNewSkillsPerRun.description: New-skill model calls per pass. Default 2; 0 = unlimited.

maxReplayExamples.description: Positive + negative prompts replayed per candidate. Default 40; 0 = unlimited.

replayConcurrency.description: Concurrent replay judgments. Default 4; 0 = all at once.

replayTimeoutMs.description: Per replay judgment. Default 0 = the decision model's unbounded default.

replayMinUsefulness.description: Replay activation threshold. Defaults to the production Skill Whisperer threshold.

minPitfallEvidence.description: Hurt outcomes + post-mortems a skill needs before a pitfall patch is drafted. Default 2.

maxEvidencePerSkill.description: Evidence items sent per skill. Default 12; 0 = unlimited.

maxEvidenceChars.description: Characters per evidence item or example prompt. Default 1200; 0 = unlimited.

maxSkillBodyChars.description: Characters of the live SKILL.md sent to the model. Default 8000; 0 = unlimited.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Characters of a proposed description. Default 0 = unlimited.

allowedCorpora.description: Crystal corpora allowed into new-skill mining; every corpus a crystal cites must be listed. Default ["memory", "knowledge"]; add "sessions" / "extracted" to opt in.

allowedAudiences.description: Crystal audiences allowed into new-skill mining. Default ["workspace"]; "*" = any audience.

allowedChatTypes.description: recall_queries chat types whose prompts may be replayed or quoted to the model. Default ["workspace", "channel"]; "unknown" covers rows recorded without one.

newSkillMinHits.description: An STM crystal qualifies for new-skill mining with at least this many hits (LTM always qualifies). Default 3.

coverageMinOverlap.description: Token overlap at which an existing skill already covers a crystal's theme. Default 0.5.

timeoutMs.description: Per model call; 0 = unlimited (the pass signal still aborts).
